about_the_game:
What is "The Grand Planto Heists?

The Grand Planto Heists is a ridiculous little 3d open-world game set in a suburban residential neighborhood. You play an average raccoon with an average raccoon obsession - stealing plants from the front gardens of these neighborhood homes. Convince other woodland critters to join you on your mission, helping heist bigger and better plants or provide cover for the humans' angry response!

"Welcome to The Grand Planto Heights, the hottest destination for the newest trends in residential landscaping design! Our homeowners compete for the prestige of having the best of the best yards in Southeastern America. Pruning hedge. Arranging annuals. Trimming tree. Our members routinely earn national awards for the excellence of their front gardens. Experience The Grand Planto Heights this summer, and witness the most grand heights a garden can achieve…"

  • Excerpt from a brochure distributed by The Grand Planto Heights HOA

All in Grand Planto Heights is peaceful and calmly competitive, until a lone raccoon comes across a daffodil that captures their little heart. Those plantos would look fantastic around their den!

You are that raccoon, and the neighborhood will never be the same! By day, hang out with your woodland friends in the Forest, and recruit help for your next heist; by night become the new menace that stalks the suburban streets of The Heights.

Current Features:

  • First stretch of Grand Planto Drive, with 7 Houses and 10 Plantos 

  • Digging and dragging of Plantos

  • Homeowner and Animal control

  • Forest Home Planto placement

Planned Features:

  • 50 Houses to terrorize and 50+ Plantos to heist, along with many trinkets & collectibles

  • A customizable Forest Home where you can place your heisted plants.

  • A quest system to unlock 20+ new woodland critters to help you on your heists

  • Trade your unwanted Plantos with Mr. Beaver's Bounty Board 

Take a tulip; purloin a petunia; join up with other woodland critters and appropriate a Japanese Maple. Become the instrument of this quaint, beautiful neighborhood's unraveling in The Grand Planto Heists!

short_description: The neighborhood will never be the same! Play as a raccoon obsessed with the front gardens of The Grand Planto Heights in this 3D digging adventure, dodging Animal Control with your woodland critter friends and stealing whatever you can scamper away with in your paws & jaws!
